In Strovolos

A bright shop on Stadiou street with classic chrome barber chairs, black tiles, wooden counters and plants. Open Tuesday to Saturday.

What customers say

Three of 305 Google reviews, 291 of them with five stars.

“By far one of the best in Cyprus. Service is different and Holic is not interested in just cutting your hair, they want to provide a great service as well. They wash your hair 3 times which is great. They provide you with oils. Creams for your hair and beard. Didn't find any other barber that does this in Nicosia”

Google review
“Excellent experience and great value. Very professional service and a high-quality haircut. The barber took time to understand what I wanted and delivered exactly that. The included hair wash before and after the cut was a pleasant surprise and made the whole experience feel premium. Definitely recommended!”

Google review
